deeds.summary: Constitution of the public limited company AMIMMO with an unlimited duration, capital of 2,500,000 francs. Corporate purpose includes real estate promotion, sale, purchase, management, and brokerage. The first financial year ends on December 31, 1997. Ordinary general meetings are held annually on May 31. Abdelhamid AMIAI and Karim AMIAI were appointed as administrators for six years, with Karim AMIAI also designated as managing director.

deeds.summary: Renewal of an administrator's mandate for EURO-EXPANSION SCRL. Document deposited on April 1, 1997.

At the general meeting of March 12, 1997, the resignation of the Board of Directors was accepted. Ludaviea Vervliet and Chris Faes were reappointed as directors, and Ludo Faes as managing director, effective from March 8, 1995, until the general meeting for the financial year 2000.
